verdict.rationale: Zep is an agent memory and context-graph service, not an automation or workflow platform, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations falls outside its product role. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships automations at all. Graphiti's temporal fact tracking, the audit and API logs, and zepctl administration concern memory data and access, not automation definitions, so they do not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
